name: Civil Engineering
description: The Department of Civil Engineering at AIKTC is a premier center of excellence for infrastructure education, sustainable construction engineering, and advanced materials research. Offering undergraduate (B.Tech), postgraduate (M.Tech in Structural Engineering and Construction Engineering & Management), and doctoral (Ph.D.) programs, the department equips engineers to design, analyze, and construct resilient mega-structures, smart transit systems, and water resource networks. The curriculum covers Structural Analysis, Concrete Technology, Soil Mechanics & Foundation Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Transportation Engineering, Remote Sensing/GIS, and Building Information Modeling (BIM).
highlights: Comprehensive academic ladder: B.Tech (30 seats), M.Tech (42 seats across Structural Engineering & Construction Management), and Ph.D. Research Center.

NABL-aligned testing and research labs including Concrete Technology Lab, Soil Mechanics Lab, Fluid Mechanics & Hydraulic Machinery Lab, Environmental Engineering Lab, and Total Station Advanced Surveying Suite.
Direct industry collaboration with infrastructure developers, municipal corporations, and structural engineering consultancies for field projects.
Placements with top construction and infrastructure conglomerates (L&T Construction, Shapoorji Pallonji, Afcons, Tata Projects, Mumbai Metro).
career_opportunities: Structural Design Engineer, Construction Project Manager, Geotechnical Engineer, Transportation & Highway Planner, Environmental Consultant, BIM Coordinator, and Site Engineer.
vision: To be the most sought after academic, research and practice based department of Civil Engineering that others would wish to emulate.

labs.name: Fluid Mechanics Lab
labs.description: Equipped with hydraulic tilting flume, Pelton wheel and Francis turbine test rigs, wind tunnel, and momentum/viscosity apparatus.

labs.name: Engineering Geology Lab
labs.description: Features a collection of approximately 550 mineral and rock samples, including metallic/non-metallic minerals and various rock types.

labs.name: Surveying Lab
labs.description: Equipped with modern surveying instruments including Total Stations, Theodolites, Auto/Tilting/Dumpy levels, GPS devices, and plane tables.

labs.name: Civil Engineering Project Lab
labs.description: Equipped with specialized design and analysis software including AutoCAD, Revit, Tekla Structures, Primavera, and Gram++ GIS.

labs.name: Transportation Engineering Lab
labs.description: Equipped with ductility, impact, and abrasion testing machines, Marshall stability apparatus, and standard penetrometers.

labs.name: Geotechnical Engineering Lab
labs.description: Equipped for Tri-axial shear, direct shear, unconfined compression, vane shear, consolidation, CBR, and soil permeability testing.

alumni_testimonial.name: Khan Sohail Mohammed Ashfaque
alumni_testimonial.quote: The faculty were supportive, and the lab facilities were excellent for practical learning. The college provided a strong foundation and helped me grow both technically and personally.
